card.name: Digits inside references and measurements
card.fires_on: A single digit, often the last digit of a number, inside a Bible verse citation or a small botanical or size measurement. It comes just before a range dash, a slash or a closing bracket.

modes.label: Bible verse numbers
modes.description: Digit in a chapter or verse number within a scripture citation.

modes.label: Sizes and ranges
modes.description: Digit in a measurement or range, such as mm, µm, or needle gauge fractions.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in a verse citation or a small measurement, often just before a dash or slash.
